fields.label: Investment Name
fields.description: How the instrument is identified on the Trust's records, e.g. "SBI FD 5yr - Hospital Fund".

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Derived from the instrument's transactions, never set by hand.

fields.label: Fund
fields.description: The one fund whose money bought this instrument. Deliberately single-valued: an FD bought from a pool holding mixed FCRA and domestic money, or mixed corpus and unrestricted money, cannot be reported in FC-4 and cannot be shown as separately identifiable corpus at audit. Buy one instrument per fund instead of co-funding one.

fields.label: FCRA Fund
fields.description: Set from the fund. An FCRA investment is bought from and redeemed into the FCRA-designated bank account, and its income is itself foreign contribution.

fields.label: Corpus Investment
fields.description: Derived from the funding fund: money out of a Corpus-class fund is a corpus holding. Corpus keeps its section 11(1)(d) exemption only while it stays separately identifiable.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: The section 11(5) / Rule 17C clause this investment is made under. An investment outside these modes makes its income taxable at 30% under section 115BBI.

fields.label: Instrument Type
fields.options:
Bank Fixed Deposit
Government Security
Post Office Scheme
PSU Bond
Debenture
Mutual Fund Units
Equity Shares
Immovable Property
Other

fields.label: Issuer
fields.description: Bank, government, corporate or fund house the instrument is issued by.

fields.label: Issuer is a PSU
fields.description: Several 11(5) clauses admit an instrument only when the issuer is a public sector company or a government undertaking.

fields.label: Counterparty
fields.description: Only where the investment is made with, or through, a person the Trust deals with. Used for the section 13(3) prohibited-person check: trust funds invested in a concern in which an interested person has a substantial interest breach section 13(2)(h).

fields.label: Folio / Certificate No
fields.description: FD receipt, folio or certificate number - the reference an auditor verifies the holding against.

fields.label: Book Value
fields.description: Cost less redemptions posted so far. Reduced by every Investment Transaction of kind Redemption or Maturity.

fields.label: Investment Account
fields.description: The balance-sheet asset account the instrument is carried in. Must be an Asset account and not a group.
